selection_protocol.method: rank every UTC Monday from 2020-01-06 through 2026-06-22 by SHA-256(seed:date), reject exact prior candidate weeks and material evaluation/context overlaps, then retain the first three unused non-overlapping weeks before any v34 performance run
selection_protocol.opening_rule: week 2 opens only after week 1 full_pass or promising_but_not_complete; week 3 opens only after week 2 also advances
selection_protocol.ablation_rule: if week 1 primary stops, run immediate-reversal-control on the identical week and identical union-plan official TradeTick stream; remove only impact-saturation asymmetry
selection_protocol.long_evaluation_rule: no long evaluation until all three frozen primary weeks advance without logic or parameter changes

frozen_market_logic.representation: daily causal cost-resolved equal-notional event bars calibrated only from the immediately preceding completed UTC day
frozen_market_logic.initiative: the existing three-event coherent aggressive-flow shock, at least 40bp move, efficient path and close beyond completed 20-event external structure
frozen_market_logic.initiative_alignment: all three initiative events must have aggressive flow and close-to-close price progress aligned with the initiative side
frozen_market_logic.impact_saturation: terminal event aggressive-flow effort is at least the median of the first two while terminal marginal price response per unit flow is below their median
frozen_market_logic.counterflow_confirmation: first completed opposite-flow adverse-price event preserves outside value and its marginal price response per unit flow exceeds the terminal initiative response
frozen_market_logic.primary_entry: NautilusTrader market bracket on the first official venue TradeTick strictly after the completed counterflow event
frozen_market_logic.single_ablation: enter every otherwise identical accepted-pullback immediate reversal without the initiative/counterflow impact-saturation comparisons
frozen_market_logic.invalidation: completed pullback outside extreme plus one 7bp side-cost buffer
frozen_market_logic.target: opposite edge of the completed pre-initiative 20-event structure
frozen_market_logic.execution_data: official Binance Vision USD-M BTCUSDT aggregate trades converted one-for-one to NautilusTrader TradeTick

structural_rationale.surviving_v31_component: immediate accepted-pullback reversal was weakly positive with 20 trades, six target hits and PF just above one, showing a nonzero failure-auction component
structural_rationale.v33_failure: completed first-resolution direction and its aggressive-flow sign did not observe passive-liquidity withdrawal or replenishment
structural_rationale.v34_hypothesis: when equal or greater terminal aggressive effort produces less marginal progress and the first opposite-flow event moves price more efficiently, passive replenishment has overtaken the initiative and the outside auction is more likely to fail
structural_rationale.anti_overfit: all comparisons are ordinal within the three completed initiative events and the first completed counterflow event; no fitted ratio, percentile, clock time or PnL threshold is introduced
